reading: Violence broke out across France on Saturday during demonstrations against hardship in schools and financial difficulties.
In Paris, there were significant clashes into the evening with riot police, who used tear gas to control crowds.
Widespread vandalism targeted businesses, and looting was reported in several major cities.
As the day continued, some groups torched vehicles in the city streets.
Local police said hostile individuals prevented firefighters from safely tackling the blaze.
Hundreds of thousands of students have also demonstrated recently over staff shortages and poor facilities in secondary schools.
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu stated that 150 police officers were injured in the unrest.
Meanwhile, Macron promised that individuals who attacked public buildings would be prosecuted.

vocabulary.definition: Severe suffering or difficulty, especially regarding money or living conditions.
Violent confrontations or physical arguments between two or more opposing groups.
The crime of intentionally damaging buildings or property belonging to other people.
The criminal activity of stealing goods from shops and homes during a violent public event.
A very large, dangerous, or fiercely burning fire.
Situations where there is not enough of a necessary resource or personnel.
A state of anger, dissatisfaction, and violent public action among a group of people.
Officially charged with a crime and judged in a court of law.

entries.ja: 経済的な問題や生活環境に関して特に、非常にひどい苦しみや困難。
entries.ko: 특히 돈이나 생활 환경과 관련하여 심한 고통이나 어려움.
entries.zh-Hans: 严重的痛苦或困难，尤其是在金钱或生活条件方面。
entries.es: Sufrimiento o dificultad grave, especialmente en relación con el dinero o las condiciones de vida.
entries.pt-BR: Sofrimento ou dificuldade grave, especialmente em relação a dinheiro ou condições de vida.
entries.fr: Souffrance ou difficulté grave, surtout en ce qui concerne l'argent ou les conditions de vie.
entries.de: Schweres Leid oder große Schwierigkeiten, besonders in Bezug auf Geld oder Lebensbedingungen.

entries.ja: 2つ以上の対立する集団の間で起こる暴力的な衝突や身体的な争い。
entries.ko: 둘 이상의 대립하는 집단 사이에서 발생하는 폭력적인 대치나 물리적인 다툼.
entries.zh-Hans: 两个或多个对立群体之间发生的暴力对抗或肢体冲突。
entries.es: Enfrentamientos violentos o altercados físicos entre dos o más grupos opuestos.
entries.pt-BR: Confrontos violentos ou embates físicos entre dois ou mais grupos opostos.
entries.fr: Affrontements violents ou disputes physiques entre deux ou plusieurs groupes opposés.
entries.de: Gewalttätige Auseinandersetzungen oder körperliche Streitigkeiten zwischen zwei oder mehr gegnerischen Gruppen.

entries.ja: 意図的に他人の建物や財産を損壊する犯罪。
entries.ko: 다른 사람의 건물이나 재산을 고의로 훼손하는 범죄.
entries.zh-Hans: 故意损坏他人建筑物或财产的犯罪行为。
entries.es: El delito de dañar intencionalmente edificios o propiedades que pertenecen a otras personas.
entries.pt-BR: O crime de danificar intencionalmente edifícios ou propriedades pertencentes a outras pessoas.
entries.fr: Le crime consistant à endommager intentionnellement des bâtiments ou des biens appartenant à autrui.
entries.de: Das Verbrechen, vorsätzlich Gebäude oder Eigentum anderer Personen zu beschädigen.

entries.ja: 暴力的な公共の出来事の際に、店や家から商品を盗む犯罪行為。
entries.ko: 폭력적인 공공 행사 중에 상점이나 집에서 물건을 훔치는 범죄 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 在暴力公共事件中，从商店和住宅窃取商品的犯罪活动。
entries.es: La actividad criminal de robar bienes de tiendas y hogares durante un evento público violento.
entries.pt-BR: A atividade criminosa de roubar bens de lojas e residências durante um evento público violento.
entries.fr: L'activité criminelle consistant à voler des marchandises dans des magasins et des maisons lors d'un événement public violent.
entries.de: Die kriminelle Aktivität, Waren aus Geschäften und Häusern während eines gewalttätigen öffentlichen Ereignisses zu stehlen.

entries.ja: 非常に大きく、危険で、激しく燃え上がる火災。
entries.ko: 매우 크고 위험하며 맹렬하게 타는 불.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常大、危险或剧烈燃烧的火。
entries.es: Un incendio muy grande, peligroso o que arde con ferocidad.
entries.pt-BR: Um incêndio muito grande, perigoso ou que queima ferozmente.
entries.fr: Un très grand incendie, dangereux ou qui brûle avec violence.
entries.de: Ein sehr großes, gefährliches oder heftig brennendes Feuer.

entries.ja: 必要な資源や人員が十分にない状況。
entries.ko: 필수적인 자원이나 인력이 충분하지 않은 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 缺乏必要资源或人员的情况。
entries.es: Situaciones en las que no hay suficiente de un recurso o personal necesario.
entries.pt-BR: Situações em que não há o suficiente de um recurso ou pessoal necessário.
entries.fr: Situations où il n'y a pas assez d'une ressource ou de personnel nécessaire.
entries.de: Situationen, in denen es an einer notwendigen Ressource oder an Personal mangelt.

entries.ja: ある集団の人々の間で怒り、不満、暴力的な公共行動の状態。
entries.ko: 어떤 집단 사람들 사이에 분노, 불만, 폭력적인 공공 행동이 있는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 一群人中存在的愤怒、不满和暴力公共行动的状态。
entries.es: Un estado de ira, insatisfacción y acción pública violenta entre un grupo de personas.
entries.pt-BR: Um estado de raiva, insatisfação e ação pública violenta entre um grupo de pessoas.
entries.fr: Un état de colère, d'insatisfaction et d'action publique violente au sein d'un groupe de personnes.
entries.de: Ein Zustand von Wut, Unzufriedenheit und gewalttätigen öffentlichen Aktionen innerhalb einer Gruppe von Menschen.

entries.ja: 正式に犯罪で告発され、法廷で裁判を受けること。
entries.ko: 공식적으로 범죄로 기소되어 법원에서 재판을 받는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被正式指控犯罪并在法庭上接受审判。
entries.es: Ser acusado oficialmente de un crimen y juzgado en un tribunal de justicia.
entries.pt-BR: Ser oficialmente acusado de um crime e julgado em um tribunal de justiça.
entries.fr: Être officiellement accusé d'un crime et jugé devant un tribunal.
entries.de: Offiziell eines Verbrechens angeklagt und vor Gericht gestellt werden.
